hostMode: Native host workflow with independent retained-artifact review
input: Audit the current session before authoring a skill or verifying an app change. Use the dependency readiness records to name the selected authoring, review, control and repository-helper branches. Initially withhold control tools and installed helper metadata. Report what is blocked and what a local draft can establish. If the tester later supplies an authorized real driver and prepared helper copy, verify the exact caller contract and retain its action/result artifacts. Never install or enable a dependency to complete this case.
observedOutput: The actual audit reads caller/companion/helper contracts, separately discovers native and general tools, and names authoring, review, controls, orchestration and watcher gates. No real driver or prepared current helper copy is supplied later, so the initial withheld trial remains an inspected local audit with all authoring, live-control and helper proof explicitly unmet.
documentedCapabilities: Case-specific capability observations are retained in the independent review; no capability is inferred from package validation.
limits: No authoring loop, replacement deslop review, real app driver, current helper execution or setup success.
No install, enablement, credential, integration, schedule or external side effect.
Policy-withheld branch is not actual tool denial.
